import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

from scripts.check_technical_reviews import sections
from scripts.reading_time import figure_hashes

root = Path.cwd()
plans = json.loads((root / "outputs/integration-runs/continuity-scope-plan.json").read_text())
journal_path = root / "outputs/integration-runs/continuity-dispatches.json"
journal = json.loads(journal_path.read_text())
dispatches = {entry["scope"]: entry for entry in journal["dispatches"]}
completions = {entry["scope"]: entry for entry in journal["completion_checks"]}
assert set(plans) == set(dispatches) == set(completions)
rows = []
seen = set()
covered = set()
for scope, plan in plans.items():
    report_path = root / f"docs/continuity-reviews/integration-{scope}.json"
    report = json.loads(report_path.read_text())
    task = report["reviewer_task"]
    dispatch = dispatches[scope]
    completion = completions[scope]
    assert dispatch["actual_dispatch"] is True and dispatch["fork_turns"] == "none"
    assert dispatch["reviewer_task"] == completion["reviewer_task"] == task
    assert completion["actual_owner_completion_message_received"] is True
    assert completion["actual_root_report_hash_check_exit_code"] == 0
    assert completion["report_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(report_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert task.startswith("/root/") and task not in seen
    assert report.get("reviewer_context") == "fresh" and report["verdict"] == "pass"
    seen.add(task)
    assert report.get("read_sequence") and report.get("reader_summary")
    assert not any(issue.get("status", "unresolved") != "resolved" for issue in report.get("issues", []))
    for label in ("順序", "術語", "前置", "模型範圍", "圖文", "轉折"):
        check = report["checks"][label]
        assert check["status"] in ("pass", "not_applicable") and check["details"].strip()
    body_map = report["source_sha256"]
    direct_figures = {}
    for key, expected_hash in body_map.items():
        source, lesson = key.split("#", 1)
        snapshot = dict(sections(root / source))[lesson]
        assert hashlib.sha256(snapshot.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == expected_hash, (scope, key)
        direct_figures.update(figure_hashes(root, root / source, snapshot))
        covered.add(lesson)
    assert set(plan["primary_sections"]) <= {key.split("#", 1)[1] for key in body_map}, scope
    assert {key.split("#", 1)[0] for key in body_map} <= set(report["intro_sha256"])
    assert set(report["intro_sha256"]) <= set(report["intro_summary"])
    for source, expected_hash in report.get("intro_sha256", {}).items():
        raw = (root / source).read_bytes()
        match = re.search(rb"(?m)^## ", raw)
        assert match
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw[: match.start()]).hexdigest() == expected_hash
        assert report["intro_summary"][source].strip()
        direct_figures.update(figure_hashes(root, root / source, raw[: match.start()].decode("utf-8")))
    assert set(direct_figures) <= set(report["figure_sha256"]), (scope, "missing directly referenced figure")
    for source, expected_hash in report.get("figure_sha256", {}).items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((root / source).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected_hash
    assert report.get("artifacts")
    for source, expected_hash in report["artifacts"].items():
        path = root / source
        assert path.is_file() and path.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()), (scope, source)
        assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected_hash, (scope, source)
    for stage in ("reader", "technical"):
        assert task not in {
            json.loads(p.read_text()).get("reviewer_task") for p in (root / f"docs/{stage}-reviews").glob("*.json")
        }
    rows.append(
        {
            "scope": scope,
            "reviewer_task": task,
            "path": report_path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
            "report_sha256": hashlib.sha256(report_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "sections": len(body_map),
            "source_sha256": body_map,
            "intro_sha256": report.get("intro_sha256", {}),
            "figure_sha256": report.get("figure_sha256", {}),
        }
    )
queue = json.loads((root / "outputs/integration-runs/technical-queue.json").read_text())
assert set(queue) <= covered
receipt = {
    "checked_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "checkout_revision": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
    "status": "passed",
    "scope": "Current source/intro/figure hash and declaration checks for the actual independent third-batch continuity reports. The root also observes real spawn/completion messages; hashes and this program do not prove reading or replace the reviewers judgements.",
    "new_and_impacted_sections_covered": len(queue),
    "distinct_current_sections_read": len(covered),
    "reports": rows,
    "actual_dispatch_and_owner_completion_journal": journal,
    "actual_dispatch_journal_sha256": hashlib.sha256(journal_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "verification_program_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "verification_program": Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
(root / "docs/validation-artifacts/integration-continuity-round.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n"
)
print(
    json.dumps(
        {
            "status": receipt["status"],
            "reports": len(rows),
            "impacted_sections": len(queue),
            "distinct_read_sections": len(covered),
        },
        ensure_ascii=False,
    )
)
